scope: Training-family manipulation pilot; same scripted phase sequencer, same 32 measured probe steps, no inference weight updates. Same frozen estimator applied separately to position and tool-Z-direction statistics. Direction scale .15; yaw unconstrained. No learned grasp/phase decisions.
calibration: V2 correction: 32 steps of home-relative joint targets, offsets uniform +/-.012 rad held for four steps; aperture open, no reset, measured q feedback. Counts in task budget; all calibration contact retained. V2 grasp/lower waypoints raised 1 cm for physical finger clearance; same correction for all methods. Observed development tasks, not independent evaluation.
